sources.evidence_limit: Computed record temporaries and host-fed waiting are explicit Pythonic contracts, not native stack, serial or controller equivalence
Portable supplied-pixel exports; no native FANUC binary image format or camera acquisition claim

computed_using.capture: Function/constructor/operator record values and nested selections become independent checked temporaries once, left to right; named/grouped storage remains a live reference
computed_using.lifetime: No copy-back, preserved missing scalar leaves and ordinary schema/readonly guards; handlers retain their captured references across later entries
computed_using.boundary: Whole ARRAY/resource/joint selectors, private-root FOR counters/connected timers, method-like field calls and entry into uncaptured scopes remain rejected

serial_waiting.configuration: Finite defaults remain unchanged; per-port wait=true opts into nonfinal input, final=true or finish_input supplies EOF; finalized waiting ports reject new feeds
serial_waiting.publication: Capture targets/formats once, probe complete ASCII/binary responses, wait at checkpoints and publish all values/cursor once; malformed/final incomplete input preserves outputs and prefix
serial_waiting.lifetime: Explicit standalone sleeper or scheduler only; pending READ blocks close/direct reads, generator cancellation removes pending registration, explicit FILE close still commits RX consumption
serial_waiting.persistence: Waiting flags, remaining bytes and TX only after close; no pending references, callbacks, native connection or suspended execution is restored

alpha_images.data: Exact packed G/GA/RGB/RGBA 8-bit samples; preserve alpha and colors beneath zero alpha without premultiplication
alpha_images.png: Color types 0/4/2/6 with checked chunks and CRCs
alpha_images.bmp: Legacy G/RGB artifacts remain byte-identical; alpha exports use V4/BITFIELDS32 BGRA, explicit masks and a portable sRGB tag
alpha_images.limits: Raw and combined quota preflight before decoding, encoder raster validation and expanded-output limits before publishing; no calibration/color conversion

historical_notes: Supersedes blanket computed-USING, waiting-serial and supplied-alpha exclusions; preserve original per-feature ledger versions and strict regressions.
